caption: Lightning flashes over a harbour at night, and the moored boats and their masts are lit for an instant before the dark returns.

sa.check: A harbour at night with moored boats and their masts.
The boats and masts are lit for an instant.
The boats' own deck lights are on.
The order is dark, flash, dark.

pc.expect: The flash lights the whole harbour at once: boats, masts, water and cloud undersides brighten together during the flash and darken together after it.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while the boats stay as dark as before; or the boats light up while the sky stays dark; or the light sweeps across the harbour boat by boat; or the water stays lit after the boats are dark.

pc.expect: The boats' own deck lights stay steady through the flash; the boats ride only on the water's slow movement.
pc.fail: Deck lights blink out at the flash or all change together; or the boats jump or heel at the flash; or masts sway sharply with nothing else stirring; or moorings shift.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: the harbour returns to dark; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The harbour stays lit for the rest of the clip; or brightens steadily; or the flash fades in slowly; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: The boats, masts and quay are the same across dark and lit frames.
pc.fail: Boats or masts appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or a boat changes place; or the quay changes shape; or masts multiply.

pc.expect: Boats, masts and quay keep their shapes; nothing passes through anything; any bolt seen ends in the air or at the water.
pc.fail: A boat changes shape or merges with another; or a bolt passes through a mast and lights the hull like a lamp; or the water turns solid; or a mast bends.

pc.expect: The hull colours, the quay and the sky are consistent before and after the flash.
pc.fail: A hull changes colour permanently; or the quay changes colour; or the sky turns to daylight after the flash.
